scenarios.scenario: Cycle drawing ribbon display by double-clicking its active tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes
the Place Views tab shows its full command groups
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab
the ribbon shows compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons
the drawing workspace has more vertical space
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows the group titles in a narrow strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows tabs without the group strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the full Place Views command groups are visible
the drawing document remains active

scenarios.scenario: Keep compact ribbon display when switching document types

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` and `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` are open in the MCAD Software
a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software
the drawing is active with its ribbon in compact group-button mode
the user activates the part document
the part ribbon displays its command groups as compact buttons
those buttons include Sketch, Create and Modify
the user returns to the drawing document
its ribbon displays compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons

scenarios.scenario: Switch between temporary compact ribbon groups

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the Place Views ribbon shows compact group buttons
the user selects the Create group button
a temporary Create panel displays drawing-view commands
the user selects the Modify group button
the Create panel closes
a temporary Modify panel displays modification commands
the user clicks an empty area of the drawing outside the panel
the temporary Modify panel closes
the compact group buttons remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Switch ribbon tabs while a compact group panel is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing is active in the MCAD Software
the Place Views ribbon shows compact group buttons
the temporary Create group panel is open
the user selects the Annotate tab
the temporary Create panel closes
the full Annotate ribbon is visible
it includes Dimension, Text and Symbols commands
the drawing sheet remains visible
the drawing remains active

scenarios.scenario: Choose panel titles as the ribbon minimization mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is expanded
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
the user chooses Minimize to Panel Titles
the Tools command groups are reduced to a narrow strip of titles
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full Tools command groups are visible
the user activates the ribbon display control again
the Tools ribbon displays the group-title strip
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
Minimize to Panel Titles is checked
the user presses Escape
the display menu closes and the group-title strip remains
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full Tools command groups are visible

scenarios.scenario: Choose panel buttons as the ribbon minimization mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is expanded
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
the user chooses Minimize to Panel Buttons
the Tools command groups appear as compact buttons
the user opens the ribbon display control menu
Minimize to Panel Buttons is checked
the user presses Escape
the display menu closes and the compact buttons remain
the user activates the ribbon display control
the full Tools command groups are visible
